data.one_liner: Type-safe API to read, modify, and write pubspec.yaml while preserving comments.
data.what_it_does: pubspec_manager lets you load a pubspec.yaml into a strongly typed object, change any field or comment, and write it back. It keeps all comments and non‑spec content intact.
use_when: You need to programmatically update a pubspec and keep comments
You want a type‑safe interface for pubspec manipulation
You need to read/write pubspecs in a build script or CI
avoid_when: You only need simple YAML parsing
You are working on a very large monorepo where performance is critical
strengths: Full support for all documented pubspec keys
Allows access to non‑spec content via Document view

alternatives.name: yaml
alternatives.why_pick_it: General YAML parsing without comment preservation

alternatives.name: pubspec_parse
alternatives.why_pick_it: Simple pubspec parsing but no comment support
